title: Sectionwise ordinary module open counit compatibility
statement: For the objects and morphisms of lem-pc-mayer-vietoris-ordinary-open-counit-square, the two displayed composite sheaf morphisms have equal components on every open of U.

source.place: Tag 08FE, proof: the underived open restriction/direct-image identity; Tag 08BV, open restriction maps. Official pages https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08FE and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08BV read 2026-10-14. The counit normalization calculation expands the existing parent proof.

proof.text: Apply extensionality to the component map and then function extensionality on its section elements. The resulting elementwise equality is the section-element theorem, proved by the sectionwise restriction calculation.
